This Suo Motu Case is dealt with in an extraordinary manner by the Dedicated Bench, pursuant to Suo Motu W.P.(Crl.) No.618 of 2025.

2.This case, Cr.No.376 of 2019 is registered for the alleged offences under Sections 294(b), 342, 323,
324 and 506(2) IPC.
The parties have moved on and have no objection to the case being disposed of on compromise.

Due to https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 16/10/2025 08:39:43 pm )
the unique manner in which this designated bench conducts hybrid hearings, the filing of written affidavits or terms of compromise is dispensed with.
3.Considering the factual matrix, the context in which the conflict arose, the background of the parties, and their present position, this is an appropriate case for the exercise of jurisdiction under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure as per Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab and another The Sub - Inspector Of Police vs Vetrivel on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67856905/
1 (2012 10 SCC 303).
4.Accordingly, the case in C.C.No.18 of 2020 of District Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate Court,
Kalasapakkam, stands quashed.
